finalists.label: Diverticulitis
finalists.why: The presence of duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency strongly supports this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Gastrointestinal lymphoma
finalists.why: The combination of worsening abdominal pain, distention, and constipation, along with leukocytosis and mesenteric lymphadenopathy, makes this a strong candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of duodenal diverticula and wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, as seen on the CT scan, specifically supports Diverticulitis over the more general symptoms and findings that could also fit Gastrointestinal lymphoma.
